microtheory.name: military_strategy
microtheory.definition: Military strategy + warfare. Sun Tzu, Clausewitz, Jomini, Mahan, Liddell Hart, Boyd. Strategy + operations + tactics levels. Land, sea, air, cyber, space domains. Deterrence, asymmetric warfare, counterinsurgency. Substrate analogue: discipline of organised conflict under uncertainty — relevant to game theory, adversarial systems, security.

concepts.name: war
concepts.definition: Organised armed conflict between political entities. Clausewitz: 'continuation of politics by other means'. Substrate analogue: substrate's adversarial-state mode.

concepts.name: strategy_military
concepts.definition: Pursuit of political ends through military means. Long-term + force-employment design. Substrate analogue: substrate's high-level goal pursuit.

concepts.name: operations_military
concepts.definition: Intermediate level. Campaigns + theaters. Joining tactics to strategy. Soviet operational art.

concepts.name: tactics
concepts.definition: Battlefield-level engagement. Use of forces in contact. Substrate analogue: substrate's immediate action selection.

concepts.name: grand_strategy
concepts.definition: Whole-of-nation. Diplomacy + economy + ideology + military integrated. Liddell Hart.

concepts.name: sun_tzu_art_of_war
concepts.definition: ~500 BCE. 'Supreme excellence: subduing enemy without fighting'. Deception, terrain, intelligence, psychology. Most-quoted strategy text.

concepts.name: clausewitz_on_war
concepts.definition: Carl von Clausewitz ~1832. War as politics. Fog of war + friction + Trinity (rational policy + passion + chance). Center of gravity.

concepts.name: jomini_strategy
concepts.definition: Antoine-Henri Jomini. Principles + lines of operation + interior lines. Geometric. Influenced US Civil War.

concepts.name: mahan_sea_power
concepts.definition: Alfred Thayer Mahan 1890. Sea power + commercial control determine national greatness. Influenced naval buildups WWI.

concepts.name: liddell_hart_indirect
concepts.definition: B.H. Liddell Hart. Indirect approach. Strike unexpected to dislocate. Influenced Blitzkrieg.

concepts.name: boyd_ooda_loop
concepts.definition: John Boyd. Observe → Orient → Decide → Act. Cycle faster than enemy. Substrate analogue: substrate's perception-action loop.

concepts.name: principles_of_war
concepts.definition: Objective, offensive, mass, economy of force, manoeuvre, unity of command, security, surprise, simplicity. Nine in US doctrine.

concepts.name: concentration_force
concepts.definition: Mass at decisive point. Defeat in detail. Substrate analogue: substrate's resource concentration.

concepts.name: fog_of_war
concepts.definition: Clausewitz. Uncertainty pervades. Commanders decide with incomplete information. Substrate analogue: substrate's bounded-information decision-making.

concepts.name: friction_war
concepts.definition: Clausewitz. Plans disrupted by small failures + delays + miscommunications. 'Everything in war is simple, but the simplest is difficult.'

concepts.name: center_of_gravity
concepts.definition: Clausewitz. Decisive source of strength to attack. Modern doctrine: enemy strategy's lynchpin.

concepts.name: decisive_point
concepts.definition: Geographic position or event enabling decisive advantage. Jomini.

concepts.name: offensive_defensive
concepts.definition: Offensive seizes initiative; defense conserves force. Clausewitz: defense stronger but offensive can decide.

concepts.name: manoeuvre_warfare
concepts.definition: Defeat enemy by movement + position rather than attrition. WWII Wehrmacht, Boyd, USMC reform.

concepts.name: attrition_warfare
concepts.definition: Wear down enemy through casualties + resource depletion. WWI Western Front. Costly.

concepts.name: blitzkrieg
concepts.definition: Lightning war. Combined arms (armor + air + radio) breakthrough + exploitation. Wehrmacht 1939-41.

concepts.name: counterinsurgency
concepts.definition: COIN. Defeating irregular forces among population. Hearts-and-minds. Galula, Petraeus.

concepts.name: asymmetric_warfare
concepts.definition: Conflict between forces of very different capabilities. Guerrilla, terrorism, insurgency. Mao's Three Stages.

concepts.name: deterrence
concepts.definition: Preventing action through credible threat. Schelling. Nuclear deterrence + extended deterrence.

concepts.name: mutual_assured_destruction
concepts.definition: MAD. Both sides capable of devastating retaliation. Strategic stability through vulnerability. Cold War foundation.

concepts.name: nuclear_triad
concepts.definition: Land + sea + air-launched nukes. Multiple delivery survivable. Second-strike capability.

concepts.name: first_strike_second_strike
concepts.definition: Capability to attack first vs survive + retaliate. Stability requires second-strike on both sides.

concepts.name: intelligence_military
concepts.definition: Information about adversary. HUMINT + SIGINT + IMINT + OSINT + cyber. Substrate analogue: substrate's adversary modelling.

concepts.name: deception_military
concepts.definition: Sun Tzu: 'All war is deception'. Operation Bodyguard 1944. Substrate analogue: substrate's adversarial obfuscation.

concepts.name: psychological_warfare
concepts.definition: Targeting morale + cohesion + will. Propaganda + information operations. Substrate analogue: substrate's adversarial influence.

concepts.name: domain_warfare
concepts.definition: Land + sea + air + cyber + space + information. Joint operations across. Modern doctrine integrates.

concepts.name: cyberwarfare
concepts.definition: Network + information attacks. Stuxnet 2010. Norms still developing. Substrate analogue: substrate's adversarial-information environment.

concepts.name: hybrid_warfare
concepts.definition: Mix of conventional + irregular + cyber + information. Russia in Ukraine 2014. Hard to attribute, respond.

concepts.name: just_war_theory
concepts.definition: Jus ad bellum (right to war) + jus in bello (right conduct in war). Augustine + Aquinas + Walzer.

rules.name: clausewitz_war_serves_politics
rules.head: Jabberwock analyses armed conflict
rules.body: war is continuation of politics by other means (Clausewitz). Stripped of political purpose, military action loses coherence. Substrate's means-end analysis.

rules.name: fog_and_friction_pervade_real_operations
rules.head: Jabberwock plans operations
rules.body: fog (uncertainty) + friction (small failures compounding) always degrade plans. Robust plans assume both. Substrate's degraded-plan robustness.

rules.name: ooda_loop_advantage_compounds
rules.head: Jabberwock competes with adversary
rules.body: cycling perception-action faster than adversary causes them to react to outdated situation. Boyd. Substrate's tempo advantage.

rules.name: deterrence_requires_credibility
rules.head: Jabberwock practices deterrence
rules.body: threat must be perceived credible + costly to adversary. Capability + will both required. Schelling. Substrate's credible-threat principle.

rules.name: insurgency_competes_for_population_loyalty
rules.head: Jabberwock analyses counterinsurgency
rules.body: win by separating insurgents from population + addressing grievances. Pure force counterproductive. Galula. Substrate's relational-conflict resolution.
